notes: Card: '-sensitive' 16-megapixel BSI, 6.39-Inches Super AMOLED, 5.5" FHD AMOLED, 720p HD touchscreen, all in phone announcements; the - pole fires on phone brand names (Droid) instead. Probes: phone spec sentences .72 / .49; phone talk without specs .06 / .04, laptop display .05, oven .01.
